name: plan-critic
description: Critique an implementation plan before approving execution. Persona reviewers (Skeptic, Architect, Verifier) evaluate the plan against the codebase and return an Approve/Reject/Refine verdict.

interface.shortDescription: Challenge implementation plans before coding starts
interface.longDescription: Triages an implementation plan, builds a Grounding Brief from the codebase, runs the Skeptic, Architect, and Verifier persona reviews, and returns one Approve/Reject/Refine verdict with concrete refinements. Runs the personas sequentially on Codex.
defaultPrompt: Use $plan-critic to challenge this implementation plan before coding starts.
Run $plan-critic on the plan in this conversation.
